title: Malay Chetty creole language
displaytitle: Malay Chetty creole language

titles.display: Malay Chetty creole language

extract: The Malay Chetty creole language is a Malay-based creole spoken by the Chetties, a distinctive group of Tamil people found mainly in Malacca in Malaysia and Singapore, who have adopted Chinese and Malay cultural practices whilst also retaining their Hindu heritage.
